summary: Navigator Holdings Ltd. filed a Form 6-K reporting that its JVCO subsidiaries, Navigator Amundsen AS and Navigator Archer AS, entered into a senior secured post-delivery term loan facility with ING Bank, Société Générale, and OCBC. The facility provides up to $121.8 million to fund 70% of the cost of two ammonia-fuelled liquefied ammonia carriers under construction in China, with delivery expected in May and September 2028. The loan has a six-year tenor, SOFR plus 1.35% interest, and is guaranteed by the company. This is routine financing for vessel construction, not a special situation.
